chunks: And it was narrated from Samāʿah, who said:

I asked Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام about the woman experiencing istihādah. He said: "She fasts the month of Ramadan except for the days in which she used to menstruate, then she makes them up after it."

key_terms.الْأَيَّامَ: the specific days excluded from fasting
key_terms.الْمُسْتَحَاضَةِ: a woman experiencing irregular non-menstrual bleeding
key_terms.تَقْضِيهَا: she makes up the missed fasts later
key_terms.شَهْرَ رَمَضَانَ: the month of Ramadan in which fasting is obligatory

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on fasting in Ramadan for a woman experiencing istihadha?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning the mustahadah during the month of Ramadan. It states that she fasts throughout Ramadan except for the days corresponding to her usual menstruation, and she must make up those missed fasts afterward.
